_source: SIA 265/1:2018, Tableau 17a and 17b -- transcribed from the French edition, SIA265-1-2018-FR.pdf p. 39: the numbers taken from the page's text layer and every row checked on a render of the page (issue #110). The only copy of these values in the project.
_note: Footnote 1 of a: the properties hold at hygroscopic equilibrium, 65 % relative humidity and 20 °C. Footnote 2 of a: the 5 % fractile of a modulus is 0,8 times its mean. The b table gives the design values for moisture class 1 and medium load duration (KLED moyenne); for any other, 6.1.2.1 (f_d = η_mod · f_k / γ_M, Tableaux 6 and 9). A cell the norm marks «valeurs non disponibles» is null and listed in the product's `unavailable`. Columns: (t_min, t_max] in mm, `from_inclusive` where the norm writes «≥».
